goal: Activate the canonical async Gear stat-snapshot API and one-child fenced PostgreSQL worker with bounded health/admin and legacy usage telemetry, while leaving active frontend consumers on the legacy endpoint until Slice 5C.
userValue: Verified SimC character-stat snapshots can be deduplicated, recovered and cached without running SimC in an HTTP request thread or mixing incompatible revisions.
nonGoals: No removal or response-shape change for /api/websim/gear/stats
No more than one SimC child

mustChange: canonical POST /api/websim/gear/stat-snapshots re-resolves and builds a server-owned stat_snapshot_v1 signature
cache hit returns 200, miss/get-or-start returns 202, and worker/runtime/saturation/cooldown returns structured 503
one systemd worker claims with fenced lease, heartbeats during SimC, re-resolves before execution and rejects signature drift
only verified JSON buffed_stats publishes an immutable bounded snapshot
health/admin expose bounded queue, oldest age, running, failures, cache hit rate, worker revision and heartbeat
legacy endpoint telemetry is best-effort and cannot break compatibility
mustNotChange: standard Profile flavor or legacy stat response shape
active Manifest, public observed-only templates or Phase 4 refresh
evidenceRequired: red-to-green API, worker, heartbeat, recovery, health, deploy and legacy compatibility tests
request thread proof that SimC is never called
candidate 202 to worker to 200 real SimC snapshot flow and duplicate single-flight
worker stopped 503 miss plus readable verified hit
candidate resource, latency, query, service, log, runtime parity and rollback evidence
backend/full verification, local CR and exact-head CI

ownership.factOwner: server/gear_stat_snapshot_api.py owns canonical async request orchestration; server/gear_stat_snapshot_worker.py owns one-child lease/heartbeat/execution orchestration; server/gear_stat_snapshot_store.py remains sole SQL owner

engineeringHealth.reason: This activates a write-capable queue and external SimC child. HTTP/worker authority separation, signature drift, heartbeat fencing, recovery, backpressure, bounded output and resource impact must be proven before frontend traffic moves.

acceptanceEvidence: python3 -m unittest tests.gear_stat_snapshot_api_test tests.gear_stat_snapshot_worker_test tests.gear_stat_snapshot_store_test tests.news_backend_test tests.websim_payload_test
candidate real SimC 202-to-200, duplicate, worker-down, reclaim, health, service, resource and post-merge smoke

decisionLog.decision: Verified cache hits remain readable when the worker is unavailable; new misses return structured 503 and do not queue without a fresh matching worker heartbeat.
Worker re-resolves and recomputes the signature immediately before SimC; stored requests are not execution authority.
Slice 5B enables exactly one worker child. Frontend cutover waits for Slice 5C.
